user.title: HS Veitur
user.description: Enter the API keys issued by HS Veitur and your customer ID (kennitala). Validation calls the API, which can take a few minutes.

error.invalid_auth: HS Veitur rejected the keys or customer ID.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach HS Veitur (it can be slow; try again).

abort.already_configured: This customer ID is already configured.

init.title: Custom pricing
init.description: Enter your own prices per kWh, excluding VAT, to get a cost statistic (hsveitur:cost_<meter>) for the Energy dashboard. Check your bills: the grid rate is HS Veitur's distribution + transmission + equalization per kWh; the energy rate is from your electricity retailer. Leave both empty to turn cost tracking off. A changed rate applies from the newest data onwards; history already priced is not changed.
